**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **Searched** for all detection triggers ("solicit", "induce", "recruit", "hire", "employ", "personnel") and read the candidate sections (§ 30 General, § 12 Customer Responsibilities, § 16 Confidentiality).
- **No non-solicit, no-hire, or anti-poaching covenant** binds Northwind anywhere in the agreement.
- **§ 12.3 affirmatively supports us**, preserving our right to hire anyone responding to general recruitment and confirming we made no no-hire commitment — this exceeds the fallback and lands squarely on the preferred position.
- **Direction check:** the only restrictive covenant in the area (§ 12.4, barring Brightline from marketing a directly competing analytics service) runs against the Vendor and benefits us, so it is correctly left untouched.
